title: My first job
instructions: Carlos ilk işini anlatıyor. Yaşa, iş yerine ve ne kazandığına dikkat et.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: I got my first job when I was sixteen.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: I worked in a small café near my school every Saturday.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: I made coffee and washed the cups.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: The owner, Mrs Rossi, was kind, but she was very strict about time.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: I earned five pounds an hour, and I saved the money for a guitar.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: After six months, I bought it. I still play it today.

questions.prompt: How old was Carlos when he got his first job?
questions.feedback: İlk işini on altı (sixteen) yaşında buldu.
questions.evidence: I got my first job when I was sixteen.

questions.prompt: What did he buy with the money?
questions.evidence: I saved the money for a guitar.
